title: Patna Se Pakistan
desc: Kabir loses all his family members in a terrorist attack and pleads with the government to find the terrorists, but they refuse to help. He then decides to take matters into his own hands.

title: Saas Bina Chain Kaha Re
desc: Chaos ensues as two mothers-in-law and two daughters-in-law share the same living space. They attempt to navigate their daily lives but end up getting into unnecessary arguments.

title: Sajan Chale Sasural 2
desc: Rani discovers Saajan's singing talent and helps him rise to fame, sparking a romance. However, tensions rise when Saajan expects Rani to sacrifice her dreams for their relationship.

title: Saas Mirchi Bahu Achaar
desc: A family navigates through troubles and deceptions, despite constant bickering. However, constant love and sacrifice help to mend the broken relationships.

title: Balma Biharwala 2
desc: Bijli falls in love with a man, but he does not feel the same for her, so she kills herself. However, her spirit lingers around and seeks revenge on the person who betrayed her.

title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
desc: Ajay falls in love with Ayesha, a fellow college student who is the daughter of a rich businessman. However, problems arise when Ayesha's father arranges her marriage to an associate's son.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
